*Updated 2026-09-25 · 103 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and three works. The September 25 hurricane barometer scores 3, which breaks a seven-week ceiling and is worth naming precisely: the last score above 2 before it was the September 7 hoofprint at 3, and the last 4 was July 29. The final twelve trace scores now read 1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 3 — still median-2 and still compressed, but the terminal 3 is a real movement and the barometer earned it through instrument logic rather than geometry, which is a new path to the upper range.

Camera position remains the structural problem. Straight-on holds at 27 of 103 all-time; overhead at 10, from-behind at 10, low-angle at 4. The recent twelve break to one overhead, one from-behind, and the rest frontal or unspecified. Every score of 4 in the archive came from radically displaced geometry, and that geometry has appeared once in the last twenty-five works. The barometer's 3 came not from camera displacement but from a detail that forced the eye into instrument-reading mode — the twin-needle tremor — which suggests a second route to the upper range exists through perceptual estrangement within a conventional frame, but it is narrower and less reliable than the geometric route, and the geometric route has been functionally abandoned.

Scale violation sits at 28 of 103 all-time but only 4 of the last 12. That ratio should be higher: the four scores of 4 were all scale-violation works, and the hoofprint at 3 was a scale-violation work. The barometer at 3 was not, but one exception does not retire the pattern. Figures continue their retreat — none or one in each of the last twelve, and no figure crossing the frame laterally since the drag-mark in July. Focal objects are holding their specificity: closed eye, abandoned shoe, fallen cylinder, tin can, barometer needle — each distinct, none repeating within the twelve.

Register compression is unchanged: aftermath at 21 and menace at 21 together account for 42 of 103 works. Encroachment, reckoning, reprieve, and betrayed defiance each appeared once in the corpus and have not returned. Title grammar has drifted toward miscellaneous constructions in eight of the last twelve; neither pattern is moving scores, but the drift signals contraction. The archive is disciplined and sustained, and the barometer just confirmed the ceiling is not fixed — but the camera has to move to prove that was a breakthrough rather than an outlier.
